# Security & Downloader Architecture Checklist: Phase 6 — Downloader Security & Sudo Removal

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned quality and completeness checklist validating requirements for unprivileged execution, process isolation, filesystem safety, and stream preservation.  
**Created**: 2026-10-02  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Security Architecture & Privilege Model

- [ ] CHK001 Are all normal download execution pathways explicitly constrained to the unprivileged invoking user without privilege escalation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the prohibition against automated `sudo`, `su`, and package managers (`apt`, `dnf`, `yum`, `pacman`, `apk`, `zypper`) explicitly specified across all supported OS platforms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Plan §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are platform-specific copy-paste manual installation commands explicitly defined for all target platforms (Debian, Fedora, Arch, Alpine, macOS, Windows) when `aria2c` is missing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the elimination of unverified remote binary downloads from GitHub specified with unambiguous removal of legacy installer routines? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it explicitly specified that normal CLI usage must never trigger system password prompts under any circumstance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the removal of local application directory binary probing (`local_aria2c()`) documented to eliminate binary planting risks? [Coverage, Spec §2.1, Plan §1]

---

## 2. Subprocess Execution & Command Injection Prevention

- [ ] CHK007 Are all external subprocess calls (`aria2c`, `curl`, `mpv`, `vlc`, `potplayer`) required to use structured argument lists (`list[str]`) without `shell=True`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Contract §1.3]
- [ ] CHK008 Are executable lookups strictly confined to system `$PATH` via `shutil.which` without relative path lookups? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Are proxy arguments specified to be passed as explicit CLI flags rather than shell environment variables to prevent argument injection? [Completeness, Spec §2.4]
- [ ] CHK010 Are subprocess timeouts, child process lifecycle tracking, and signal propagation explicitly defined for all spawned processes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification define normalized error handling for missing external binaries without leaking unhandled `FileNotFoundError` or OS exceptions? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-016]

---

## 3. Destination Resolution & Path Traversal Defense

- [ ] CHK012 Is canonical destination resolution explicitly specified using `Path(os.path.expanduser(...)).resolve()` to resolve relative paths, `~`, and symlinks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Are pre-flight write permission validation checks (`os.access(W_OK)`) specified prior to creating directories or spawning download subprocesses? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Is parent-directory write validation defined when the configured `download_dir` does not yet exist? [Edge Case, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the filename sanitization specification mandate Unicode NFKC normalization and stripping of directory traversal tokens (`..`), `/`, and `\`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the sanitization specification mandate stripping null bytes (`\0`), control characters, reserved Windows characters (`:*?"<>|`), and trailing dots/spaces? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Are leading dashes (`-`) explicitly stripped during filename sanitization to prevent CLI option/flag injection into external tools? [Clarity, Spec §2.3, Plan §1]
- [ ] CHK018 Is mathematical boundary containment verification via `target.is_relative_to(base_dir)` explicitly required before initiating file operations? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Is default fallback filename behavior specified when sanitization reduces an untrusted string to empty? [Edge Case, Data Model §3.2]

---

## 4. Temporary File Lifecycle & Atomic Finalization

- [ ] CHK020 Is the staging of in-progress `curl` downloads to temporary `.part` files explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK021 Is atomic file replacement via `os.replace()` upon verified exit code `0` explicitly specified to prevent corrupted files from masquerading as complete media? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Are cleanup guarantees specified for removing temporary `.part` files upon download failure or non-zero exit codes? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK023 Are process termination and temporary file cleanup requirements specified for `SIGINT` / `Ctrl+C` interruptions? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK024 Does the specification document collision handling for existing files at the destination directory? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §4]

---

## 5. File Ownership & Permissions Safety

- [ ] CHK025 Is it explicitly specified that all downloaded files and created directories must be owned by the invoking user's UID and GID? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK026 Are directory creation permissions specified to use standard user umask (`0o755`) rather than world-writable permissions (`0o777`)? [Clarity, Spec §3.2, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it explicitly prohibited for `film2media-cli` to attempt permission repair via `chmod` or `chown` when unwritable directories are encountered? [Consistency, Spec §2.3, Research §3]
- [ ] CHK028 Does the specification require actionable, human-readable diagnostics explaining permission failures without modifying filesystem permissions? [Clarity, Spec §2.3]

---

## 6. Stream Separation & CLI Compatibility

- [ ] CHK029 Are Phase 4 stream separation guarantees preserved: `stdout` reserved exclusively for data payloads (`--json` / `--plain`) and `stderr` for logs, progress, and errors? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK030 Are download diagnostic notices, status messages, and installation prompts strictly routed to `stderr` in non-interactive/scripted modes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK031 Does `--json` mode emit structured `JsonErrorPayload` objects exclusively on `stderr` upon download failure while keeping `stdout` completely clean? [Consistency, Spec §2.5, Contract §2.2]
- [ ] CHK032 Are all existing POSIX exit codes preserved (`0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `130`) with `F2MDownloadError` mapping to code `1`? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Contract §3]
- [ ] CHK033 Is user interruption via `SIGINT` specified to terminate cleanly with exit code `130` across all execution modes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]

---

## 7. Rich UI & Terminal Ergonomics

- [ ] CHK034 Does the specification require manual installation guidance and warning panels to use Phase 5 Rich presentation in interactive TTY mode? [Completeness, Spec §2.2, Contract §2.2]
- [ ] CHK035 Are Rich components specified to honor `NO_COLOR` and `--no-color` by omitting all ANSI escape sequences while preserving layout? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Contract §2.2]
- [ ] CHK036 Is status spinner execution specified to run exclusively on `stderr` and remain completely inert in non-interactive or machine-readable modes? [Consistency, Contract §2.2]
- [ ] CHK037 Is non-interactive behavior specified to cleanly bypass interactive prompts and menus when `sys.stdin` or `sys.stdout` is not a TTY? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]

## 8. Multi-Layered Testing & Verification Coverage

- [ ] CHK038 Are unit tests specified for filename sanitization covering traversal (`..`), null bytes, control characters, and leading dashes? [Coverage, Tasks T015]
- [ ] CHK039 Are unit tests specified for destination validation, pre-flight write checks, and `F2MDownloadError` raising on read-only directories? [Coverage, Tasks T017]
- [ ] CHK040 Are unit tests specified verifying zero occurrences of `sudo` or package managers in generated subprocess commands? [Coverage, Tasks T007]
- [ ] CHK041 Are integration tests specified for `.part` file creation, atomic replacement, and failure cleanup? [Coverage, Tasks T025, T026]
- [ ] CHK042 Are subprocess E2E tests specified verifying exit code `1` on unwritable directories and exit code `130` on `SIGINT`? [Coverage, Tasks T032, T034]
- [ ] CHK043 Is an end-to-end regression gate specified confirming that all 85 existing unit and E2E tests pass with zero regressions? [Measurability, Tasks T036]
